000004e0.evidence: Warm/cold entry select (was ref_resetHandler_): bsr 0x572; jsr 0x170 (pool 0x586=0x170), 0x41c (0x588=0x41c), 0x3d4 (0x58a=0x3d4); param==0: cmp u32 @0xffffdffc (pool 0x5a0=0xffffdffc) vs 0x5aa5a55a (pool 0x59c=0x5aa5a55a) at 0x508; on mismatch bsr 0x5b0 with r4=7 (WDT overflow count) - magic match or overflow selects warm entry = u32 @ROM 0x1000 (pool 0x58e=0x1000; ROM 0x1000 = 0x1298), else cold 0x6c8 (pool 0x58c=0x6c8); warm branch also tests u32 @0x7fffc (pool 0x5a4=0x7fffc; ROM 0x7fffc = 0x2000) with fallback u32 @0x7fff8 (pool 0x5a8=0x7fff8; ROM 0x7fff8 = 0xd204); writes 0x5aa5a55a to 0xffffdffc at 0x562-0x566, jsr 0x40 (pool 0x594=0x40) with r4 = chosen entry, halt. param!=0 branch stores param_2 byte to 0xffffdfa8 (pool 0x590=0xdfa8) and selects cold 0x6c8.

0000d20c.evidence: Was ref_handleManualReset_: r1 = pool 0xd2c8=0xd730 (cell holding 0xffff768c), jsr 0x4c7a (pool 0xd2cc=0x4c7a) with r4 = *(0xd730), jsr 0x9e68 (pool 0xd2d0=0x9e68, recovery_finalize_set_pf3_halt), halt at 0xd21a. Entered from the recovery block at 0xd204 (ldc vbr 0x7fc50 pool 0xd2c0=0x7fc50, lds fpscr 0x40001 pool 0xd2c4=0x40001, then falls into 0xd20c); 0xd204 is the value of u32 @ROM 0x7fff8.

00001038.evidence: Was ref_reset_ZERO: jsr 0x1364 (pool 0x107a=0x1364), 0x109c (0x107c=0x109c, ref_resetOBDCAN_), 0x16dc (0x107e=0x16dc); param!=0 -> jsr 0x12a2 (pool 0x1080=0x12a2) then entry 0x1378 (pool 0x1082=0x1378); param==0 -> flash-pointer check u32 @0x7fffc (pool 0x1088=0x7fffc) with fallback u32 @0x7fff8 (pool 0x108c=0x7fff8; ROM 0x7fff8 = 0xd204); jsr 0x1090 (pool 0x1084=0x1090; mov.l pool 0x1098 to r15, jmp @r4) then halt at 0x1076.

000006c8.evidence: Cold entry monitor loop (selected by pool 0x58c=0x6c8 in 0x4e0): zeroes 0xffffdfb8 (pool 0x796=0xdfb8); loop jsr 0x364 (pool 0x7a4=0x364; dispatches on reset cause 0xffffdfa8), remaining-count jsr 0x3e0 (pool 0x79e=0x3e0), ring record ptr jsr 0x3b0 (pool 0x7a6=0x3b0; 100 x 8-byte records at 0xffffd4e0); on pending record dispatches on first byte: 'z' with second byte & 0xf8 (pool 0x7a2=0xf8) -> handlers 0x806/0x4c/0x64/0x7c0/0x7c/0x8a/0xc0 (pools 0x7a8-0x7b6), 0xff/0xc8 -> 0xd8; services WDT via jsr 0x31c (pool 0x7be=0x31c).

00009ea2.evidence: Key-off wait/halt: SR = (SR & 0xff0f) | 0xf0 (pool 0x9f1c=0xff0f); ref_setSR_PARAM 0xe0 (pool 0x9f18=0xe0, jsr pool 0x9f28=0x2054); ref_setRegister_REG_BIT_VAL PFDR_W 0xfffff74e (pool 0x9f1a=0xf74e) mask 8 val 0 (r5=8 r6=0, jsr pool 0x9f2c=0x4bbc); loop 0x9ed0: busy-wait jsr 0x239c with r4=0x1388 (pools 0x9f40=0x239c, 0x9f1e=0x1388), WDT pulse jsr 0xa850 (pool 0x9f3c=0xa850), r0 = PFDR_W & 1 (r14=1) at 0x9ed8-0x9ee2; loops while bit0 == 0, bsr 0x9efe (masked halt) once bit0 == 1. Called from 0x252c2 via pool 0x253a8=0x9ea2.

00009e68.evidence: Finalize path called from the 0xd204 recovery entry (pool 0xd2d0=0x9e68): jsr 0x4c80 (pool 0x9f20=0x4c80), jsr 0xd518 (pool 0x9f24=0xd518, RAM swap + SBL semaphore mark), bsr 0x9f0c r4=0; ref_setSR_PARAM 0xe0 (pool 0x9f18=0xe0, jsr pool 0x9f28=0x2054); PFDR_W 0xfffff74e bit 3 = 1 (pool 0x9f1a=0xf74e, r5=8 r6=1, jsr pool 0x9f2c=0x4bbc); jsr 0x2064 (pool 0x9f30), jsr 0x4cf0 (pool 0x9f34), jsr 0x3ad8 r4=0 (pool 0x9f38); halt at 0x9e9e.

0000d21e.evidence: Was ref_main__ (referenced from the task area via pool 0x655c near 0x64f6): bsr 0xd262 (pools 0xd2dc=0xd934, 0xd2e0=0x9890) and 0xd28e (pools 0xd2e4=0xffffa3e8, 0xd2bc=0x450); if result != -1 and byte @0xffff9f8c (pool 0xd2d4=0xffff9f8c) != 1: SR = (SR & 0xff0f) | 0xf0 (pool 0xd2b8=0xff0f), jsr 0x4e0 (pool 0xd2d8=0x4e0) with r4=1 r5=result - software reset via the param!=0 branch of 0x4e0, which stores the cause byte at 0xffffdfa8; halt 0xd258.

00006796.evidence: Sticky update of the input latches: 0xffff9ec8 = (prev 0xffff9ed8 | PFDR_W) & 0xffff9ec8 | prev & PFDR_W (pools 0x684a=0xf74e, 0x6850=0xffff9ed8, 0x6854=0xffff9ec8); same for PHDR_W 0xfffff72c (pool 0x684c=0xf72c) -> 0xffff9eca (pools 0x685c/0x6858); three expander channels via 0x70ac -> 0xffff9ecc/9ecd/9ece.

000070ac.evidence: Was ref_getFromGPIO_: external GPIO-expander read over SCI0 - reconfigures SCI0 (regs 0xfffff002/0xfffff000/0xfffff006/0xfffff001, pools 0x7160/0x7164/0x7166/0x7168), selects channel via PHDR_W 0xfffff72c (pool 0x716c=0xf72c) masks 0x4000/0x8000 (pools 0x716a=0x4000, 0x7180=0x8000) through 0x4bbc (pool 0x7170), sends 0xff (pool 0x716e=0xff) via 0x71ea (SCI0 exchange, toggles PGDR_W 0xfffff764 bit 1), returns the received byte; callers 0x6744/0x6796 store it to 0xffff9ecc/9ecd/9ede.

0001a5d8.evidence: 0xffffaa69 = (vehicle latch 0xffff9ec8 & 1) != 0: mov.l pool 0x1a610=0xffff9ec8, store pool 0x1a60c=0xffffaa69; called from 0x19640 and 0x19950. PFDR bit0 is the key-on (IG1) input sampled by 0x6744 vehicle_inputs_poll_pfdr_phdr.

0001a600.evidence: Copies 0xffffaa69 (pool 0x1a60c) to engine_running_flag 0xffffaa68 (pool 0x1a60a=0xaa68); called from 0x19640/0x19950. 0xffffaa68 gates the CAN RX/TX mains (0xdbf6/0xdb58), CAN error recovery 0xdcc0, the fan after-run clause in 0x2f51a and the key-off state machine 0x252c2.

000454c0.evidence: Reads PFDR_W (pool 0x45508=0xf74e), stores 0xffffcbd1 = (PFDR & 0x8000) == 0 (mask pool 0x4550c=0x8000, cell pool 0x45510=0xffffcbd1); called from 0x19640. PF15 is a second key-related input pin.

000454d2.evidence: Edge latch on PF15: reads PFDR_W & 0x8000 (pools 0x45508=0xf74e, 0x4550c=0x8000); on pin 1->0 sets 0xffffcbd0 = 1 (pool 0x4550a=0xcbd0), on 0->1 clears it; keeps 0xffffcbd1 (pool 0x45510) as previous sample; called from 0x199d4; consumed by 0x48d38 key_voltage_timer_update.

00048d38.evidence: 0xffffccca held at 0x19 while (battery voltage 0xffffb590 < 6.0 and 0xffffcbd0 == 1), else counts down to 0; read by 0x48d70 into 0xffffccc4. Candidate START/crank correlation (PF15 active + low voltage); terminal routing unresolved.

00048d70.evidence: Sets 0xffffccc5/0xffffccc2 = (voltage 0xffffb590 >= 6.0), 0xffffccc4 = (ccc2 && 0xffffccca == 0), 0xffffccc3 = (0xffffaa68 && 0xffffccc1 && stored 0xffffb4ed == 1); voltage/key sanity inputs to the shutdown decision.

00048cc0.evidence: Computes 0xffffccc1 (pool 0x48da2): = 1 only when (engine flag 0xffffaa68 == 1 (pool 0x48d92) or (0xffffb4ee == 1 (pool 0x48d94) && 0xffffccb6 < 0x271 (pool 0x48d96))) and 0xffffcca0 == 0 (pool 0x48d98) and not 0xffffad60/0xffffad61 (pools 0x48d9a/0x48d9c) and E2-shadow 0xffff80a2 != 1 (pool 0x48d9e, read via 0x3db54 pool 0x48db0) and 0xffffb51a == 0 (pool 0x48da0); else 0. Drives the PD11 relay-hold output via 0x251d0.

000487d6.evidence: Engine-stop/shutdown condition evaluator (called from the slow-task step 0x22f86): snapshots rpm 0xffffb548 (pool 0x48884), battery 0xffffb590 (0x48886), coolant 0xffffa98c (0x48888); rpm < 200/300 -> 0xffffccec, voltage < 5.8/6.0 -> 0xffffcced, coolant < 98/100 -> 0xffffccee/0xffffccef; reads E2-shadow flags 0xffff873c/0xffff809e/0xffff809c/0xffff8104/0xffff80a0/0xffff80a2/0xffff8764 via 0x3db54/0x3dc70; sets 0xffffccbc-bf/ccc0/ccc9 from engine flag 0xffffaa68 (pool 0x4888e), injectors-off 0xffffa42c, counters 0xffffccb4/ccb6/ccba and stored flag 0xffffb4ed.

000251d0.evidence: Relay-hold output: 0xffffb574 = (0xffffccc1 != 1) (pools 0x25278=0xffffb574, 0x2526c=0xccc1); under SR mask 0xe0 (pool 0x2526e=0xe0, jsr 0x2054 pool 0x2527c=0x2054) drives PDDR_W 0xfffff746 (pool 0x25272=0xf746) bit 0x800 (pool 0x25270=0x800) to (b574 == 1) via 0x4bbc (pool 0x25280=0x4bbc); PD11 high while shutdown is not allowed. Callers 0x22f54 (init fan-out 0x1102a) and 0x22f86 (slow task). Chip-pin -> connector-terminal routing is board-level unresolved (D2): candidates main relay control 4E / DBW relay control 4C per pinout v3.

000252c2.evidence: Key-off state machine (called from 0x253e8, itself from slow task 0x11534): state in 0xffffb57a (pool 0x25380); engine flag 0xffffaa68 (pool 0x25378) == 1 && state 0 -> arm: 0xffffdf99 = 0x5a (pool 0x2537a=0xdf99), 0xffffb580 = 0, 0xffffb579 = 1 (pool 0x25374); engine stopped && state 0 -> state 1, 0xffffb578 = 1 (pool 0x2537c); counting: 0xffffb57c (u32, pool 0x2539c) ++ saturating at -1; state 2 when b57c >= u32 @ROM 0x74940 (pool 0x253a4=0x74940; ROM word = 0x36ee8) or when b57c >= 0x19 and 0xffffb582 (pool 0x2538c) <= 0xffffb583 (pool 0x25390): then state = 2, E2-shadow 0xffff8104 = 1 via 0x3dc70 (pools 0x25376=0x8104, 0x25384=0x3dc70), 0xffffb579 = 0, 0xffffdf99 = 0, jmp 0x9ea2 (pool 0x253a8=0x9ea2).

000253e8.evidence: Interrupt-masked step wrapper: ref_setSR_PARAM 0xe0 (pool 0x2540e=0xe0, jsr pool 0x25428=0x2054), jsr 0x252c2 (pool 0x2542c=0x252c2), restore via 0x2064 (pool 0x25430); called from slow task 0x11534.

00025290.evidence: State init: 0xffffb57a = 0 (pool 0x25380=0xffffb57a), 0xffffb579 = 1 (pool 0x25374=0xb579); reached from init fan-out 0x1102a via 0x253ac.

0002529e.evidence: Clears E2-shadow 0xffff8104 = 0 via 0x3dc70 (pools 0x25376=0x8104, 0x25384=0x3dc70); reached from 0x113b8 <- 0x6366 <- 0x9f52 (boot path).

000252ae.evidence: 0xffffb582 += 1 (pool 0x2538c=0xffffb582); called from 0x253b8; compared against 0xffffb583 in the early shutdown condition of 0x252c2.

000195cc.evidence: Was ref_calculateKeyOnTime: if engine flag 0xffffaa68 == 1 (pool 0x1961c=0xaa68) then 0xffffa9e0 = saturate(0xffffa9e0 + 1) via 0x2460 (pools 0x1961a=0xa9e0, 0x19620=0x2460), else 0; called from 0x199d4.

000195f4.evidence: Was ref_calculateKeyOffTime: 0xffffa9e2 saturating ++ while 0xffffaa68 == 0 (pools 0x1961e=0xa9e2, 0x1961c=0xaa68, 0x19620=0x2460); called from 0x199d4.

Key-off stops all non-diag CAN RX processing.

0000db58.evidence: Was ref_CANTX_Main: packs TX IDs 0x41/0x201/0x251/0x231/0x240/0x250/0x420/0x620/0x630/0x650 (pools 0xdc70-0xdc98) only while error poll 0xffffa40f < 100 (pool 0xdc64), latch 0xffffa40a == 0 (0xdc5a), setup error 0xffffa410 == 0 (0xdc68), comm error 0xffffa411 == 0 (0xdc6c), engine flag 0xffffaa68 == 1 (0xdc5c) && 0xffffb578 != 1 (0xdc5e); clears 0xffffc1d1 (pool 0xdc62).

000005b0.evidence: Was ref_checkWatchdogTimer_OVRCOUNT: loops param times - stores 0x624() result into reset cause 0xffffdfa8 (pool 0x6b6=0xdfa8), jsr 0x364 (pool 0x6ba=0x364), remaining 0x3e0 (0x6bc), ring 0x3b0 (0x6be); returns 0 when a record was processed; otherwise counts WDT TCSR 0xffffec10 (pool 0x6b8=0xec10) OVF bit 0x80, servicing via 0x31c (pool 0x6c0). Called from 0x4e0 with r4=7: any overflow => warm reset.

00000572.evidence: Was ref_resetWatchdog_: RSTCSR_W 0xffffec12 = 0x5a1f (pools 0x596=0x5a1f, 0x598=0xec12), then TCSR 0xffffec10 = 0x5a00 and keyed write 0xa53c (pools 0x59a=0xec10, 0x5ac=0xa53c) - SH keyed WDT/RSTCSR write idiom (0x5a/0xa5 upper bytes).

0000a850.evidence: External watchdog heartbeat on PB15: under SR mask 0xe0 (pool 0xa88a=0xe0, jsr 0x2054 pool 0xa894=0x2054) sets PBDR_W 0xfffff738 (pool 0xa88e=0xf738) |= 0x8000 (pool 0xa89c=0x8000), busy-waits 0x96*8 via 0x239c (pools 0xa890=0x96, 0xa8a0=0x239c), then PBDR &= 0x7fff (pool 0xa88c=0x7fff). Called from the 0x9ea2 shutdown wait loop, 0x60c8 and 0xd518.

0000d518.evidence: Shutdown RAM handling (called from 0x9e68 via pool 0x9f24=0xd518): checksum 0xd648 (pools 0xd620=0xd748, 0xd61c=0xd744) over 0xffff9300..0xffffdffb; if OK: 0x4c70 (pool 0xd628) writes u32 0x3c to the SBL semaphore cell 0xffffdff8, pulses WDT 0xa850 (pool 0xd624), swaps RAM 0xffff6000-0xffff7fff with the shadow at 0xffff9300 (pools 0xd62c=0xd734, 0xd630=0xd738), re-checksums, 0x4c76 (pool 0xd634), 0xd5ac; sets 0xffffa3f0 = checksum-ok (pool 0xd638=0xffffa3f0).

ffffcbd0.evidence: Edge latch of PFDR_W 0xfffff74e bit 0x8000: set 1 on pin 1->0, cleared on 0->1 by 0x454d2 (pools 0x4550a=0xcbd0, 0x45508=0xf74e, 0x4550c=0x8000); read by 0x48d38.

ffffb57a.evidence: Key-off state machine state: 0 = armed/key-on, 1 = engine stopped (counting), 2 = shutdown (0x252c2, pool 0x25380=0xffffb57a).

ffffb578.evidence: Set 1 on the engine-stop transition by 0x252c2 (pool 0x2537c=0xb578); gates CAN RX/TX mains 0xdbf6/0xdb58 and CAN error recovery 0xdcc0.

ffffb579.evidence: Armed flag of the key-off sequence (pool 0x25374=0xb579; init 1 in 0x25290).

ffffb57c.evidence: Saturating u32 key-off timer (pool 0x2539c=0xffffb57c); shutdown when >= u32 @ROM 0x74940 = 0x36ee8 (pool 0x253a4=0x74940) or >= 0x19 with 0xffffb582 <= 0xffffb583.

ffffb582.evidence: Incremented by 0x252ae (pool 0x2538c=0xffffb582); compared with 0xffffb583 in the early shutdown condition of 0x252c2.

ffffb574.evidence: = (0xffffccc1 != 1); drives PDDR_W 0xfffff746 bit 0x800 (PD11 relay-hold output) via 0x251d0 (pool 0x25278=0xffffb574).

ffffccc1.evidence: Shutdown-allowed flag computed by 0x48cc0 from engine flag 0xffffaa68, 0xffffb4ee, 0xffffccb6 < 0x271, 0xffffcca0, 0xffffad60/ad61, E2-shadow 0xffff80a2 and 0xffffb51a (pool 0x48da2=0xccc1).

ffff8104.evidence: E2RAM-shadow shutdown flag: written 0/1 by 0x2529e/0x252c2 via 0x3dc70 (pool 0x25376=0x8104), read back by 0x487d6 as the persistent shutdown marker.

ffffa9e0.evidence: Saturating u16 key-on time, ++ while 0xffffaa68 == 1 (0x195cc; pools 0x1961a=0xa9e0, 0x1961c=0xaa68, 0x19620=0x2460).

ffffa9e2.evidence: Saturating u16 key-off time, ++ while 0xffffaa68 == 0 (0x195f4; pools 0x1961e=0xa9e2, 0x1961c=0xaa68, 0x19620=0x2460).

ffffdf99.evidence: Set to 0x5a when the key-off sequence arms, 0 on the shutdown transition (0x252c2, pool 0x2537a=0xdf99).

ffffccca.evidence: Held at 0x19 while voltage 0xffffb590 < 6.0 and 0xffffcbd0 == 1, else counts down (0x48d38); read by 0x48d70 into 0xffffccc4.

ffffdfa8.evidence: Reset-cause selector: written by the param!=0 branch of 0x4e0 (pool 0x590=0xdfa8) and by 0x5b0; selects the 0x210 vs 0x450 dispatch in 0x364/0x338.

ffffdffc.evidence: Warm-boot magic 0x5aa5a55a, written on every reset by 0x4e0 (pool 0x5a0=0xffffdffc) and compared at 0x508 to select warm vs cold entry; top-of-RAM protected cell (range-checked in 0x87c).

0x00001298.evidence: Warm entry: u32 @ROM 0x1000 = 0x1298 (loaded via pool 0x58e in 0x4e0). 6-byte stub at 0x1298 (inside the 0x1272 function body): mov.w pool 0x1348=0x1038, jsr @r3 (warm_reset_dispatcher 0x1038), mov #0,r4, bra self halt at 0x129e.

0x0000d204.evidence: Recovery entry = u32 @ROM 0x7fff8 = 0xd204 (fallback warm-entry pointer used by 0x4e0/0x1038 when the 0x1000 cell is erased): ldc r3,vbr pool 0xd2c0=0x7fc50; lds r2,fpscr pool 0xd2c4=0x40001; falls into 0xd20c manual_reset_finalize; halt 0xd21a.
